result.instructions: Tools for Cirqll, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customers in Cirqll have no task planned in the next 14 days?"; "Show the open sales chances and their expected values."; "Create a follow-up task for the Acme customer next Monday at 09:00.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cirqll data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cirqll_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cirqll_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cirqll_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cirqll_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cirqll_get_me
tools.title: Get the signed-in user
tools.description: Return the Cirqll user the access token belongs to, with roles and permissions. Use it to confirm the account. Cirqll API: GET /auth/me.

tools.name: cirqll_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers in the CRM, with paging, filter and sort. Use it for customer overviews and search. Cirqll API: GET /customer.

filter.description: Cirqll filter, field:operator:value, e.g. name:eq:"Acme". Group with (a:op:v,and,b:op:v).

order_by.description: Sort as field:direction, comma separated, e.g. name:asc or created_at:desc,name:asc. A field without a direction sorts ascending.

with.description: Related data to include, comma separated, e.g. contacts,notes. Cirqll advises not to combine it with show.

show.description: Only these fields, comma separated, e.g. name,email (id is always included). Cirqll advises not to combine it with with.
